_note: Chapter 26 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The meeting was accidental; we simply ran into each other at the station.
ex.cn: 那次相遇纯属偶然；我们只是在车站碰上了。
ex.note: by accident 偶然地

ex.en: Weekend activities at the campus include films, sports and music.
ex.cn: 校园周末的活动包括电影、体育和音乐。

ex.en: The doctor advised her to rest for a week and drink plenty of water.
ex.cn: 医生建议她休息一周，多喝水。
ex.note: advise sb. to do sth. 建议某人做某事

ex.en: The doctor told him to avoid alcohol while he was taking the medicine.
ex.cn: 医生告诉他服药期间不要碰酒。
ex.note: 含酒精的饮料

ex.en: A large amount of time went into preparing the report.
ex.cn: 准备那份报告花掉了大量时间。
ex.note: a large amount of + 不可数名词

ex.en: The repair costs amount to about two thousand yuan.
ex.cn: 维修费用合计大约两千元。
ex.note: amount to 合计为

ex.en: If anybody calls while I am out, ask him to leave a message.
ex.cn: 我出去的时候要是有人打电话，就让他留个条。

ex.en: The approximate cost of the trip was two hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 这趟旅行的费用大约是两百元。

ex.en: The repair bill approximates to eight hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 维修费大约是八百元。
ex.note: approximate to 接近于

ex.en: She asked whether the train to the city would leave on time.
ex.cn: 她问开往市里的火车会不会准点。
ex.note: ask sb. for sth. 向某人要某物；ask sb. to do sth. 请某人做某事

ex.en: His attitude towards the exam changed after he failed it once.
ex.cn: 考试挂过一次之后，他对这个考试的态度变了。
ex.note: attitude towards/to 对…的态度

ex.en: The pain in his back grew worse after the long journey.
ex.cn: 长途旅行之后，他背上的疼更厉害了。

ex.en: She stepped back and let the old man go first.
ex.cn: 她退后一步，让老人先过。
ex.note: back up 倒退；back out 退出

ex.en: The whole class backed the plan to rebuild the old hall.
ex.cn: 全班同学都支持重建老礼堂的计划。
ex.note: back sb. 支持某人

ex.en: Our plans for the new library must have a solid financial base.
ex.cn: 我们建新图书馆的计划必须建立在稳固的资金基础上。
ex.note: at the base of 在…的底部

ex.en: The whole report is based on three months of fieldwork.
ex.cn: 整份报告以三个月的实地调查为基础。
ex.note: be based on 以…为基础

ex.en: She bought a kilo of beef and some vegetables for dinner.
ex.cn: 她买了一公斤牛肉和些蔬菜做晚饭。

ex.en: The bus stops between the school and the clinic.
ex.cn: 巴士在学校和诊所之间设站。
ex.note: between … and … 在…和…之间

ex.en: Her flat is in the block next to the small park.
ex.cn: 她的公寓在小公园旁边那个街区。

ex.en: A fallen tree blocked the road for two hours.
ex.cn: 一棵倒下的树把路堵了两个小时。
ex.note: block sb. from doing 阻止某人做某事

ex.en: Sorry to bother you, but could you open the window?
ex.cn: 不好意思打扰您，能把窗户开一下吗？
ex.note: bother sb. with sth. 用某事打扰某人

ex.en: It is not worth the bother to change the ticket now.
ex.cn: 现在去换票不值得费那个事。

ex.en: The new teacher brought a lot of energy to the class.
ex.cn: 新老师给这个班带来了很多活力。
ex.note: bring about 引起；bring up 抚养

ex.en: He pressed the button on the old radio, but nothing happened.
ex.cn: 他按下旧收音机上的按钮，却什么也没发生。
ex.note: 纽扣；按钮

ex.en: The new machine has the capability of printing on both sides.
ex.cn: 这台新机器有双面打印的功能。
ex.note: capability of doing 有…的能力

ex.en: She looked up the price of the medicine in the catalogue.
ex.cn: 她在药品目录里查到了这种药的价格。
ex.note: a catalogue of … …的目录

ex.en: The heart has four chambers, and each one has its own work to do.
ex.cn: 心脏有四个腔室，各自承担不同的工作。
ex.note: chamber of commerce 商会

ex.en: We grilled some chicken and ate it in the garden.
ex.cn: 我们烤了些鸡肉，在花园里吃了。

ex.en: She claimed that she had lost her ticket, but the driver believed her.
ex.cn: 她声称车票丢了，可司机信了她。

ex.en: He made a claim against the shop for the broken vase.
ex.cn: 他就打碎的花瓶向商店提出了索赔。
ex.note: make a claim against 向…提出索赔

ex.en: The old notebook gave the police their first clue about the robbery.
ex.cn: 那本旧笔记给了警方关于这起抢劫的第一条线索。
ex.note: a clue to/about 关于…的线索

ex.en: The old chair by the window was the most comfortable seat in the house.
ex.cn: 窗边那把旧椅子是屋里最舒服的座位。
ex.note: be comfortable with 对…感到自在

ex.en: The doctor said she would make a complete recovery within a month.
ex.cn: 医生说她一个月之内就能完全康复。

ex.en: The team completed the survey in just two weeks.
ex.cn: 小组只用了两周就完成了这次调查。

ex.en: The conductor on the night bus was a cheerful old man.
ex.cn: 夜班车的售票员是个乐呵呵的老头。
ex.note: 乐队指挥；导电体

ex.en: His handwriting is consistent from the first page to the last.
ex.cn: 他的字迹从第一页到最后一页都很一致。
ex.note: be consistent with 与…一致

ex.en: The clinic was arranged for the convenience of the old patients.
ex.cn: 诊所的布置是为了方便老年病人。
ex.note: for convenience 为方便起见；at one's convenience 在某人方便时

ex.en: They live in a small cottage at the edge of the village.
ex.cn: 他们住在村子边缘的一间小屋里。

ex.en: The bridge was the creation of two young engineers.
ex.cn: 这座桥是两位年轻工程师的作品。
ex.note: the creation of … …的创造

ex.en: He opened the cupboard and took out a clean towel.
ex.cn: 他打开橱柜，取出一条干净的毛巾。
ex.note: in the cupboard 在橱柜里

ex.en: The nurse typed the patients' data into the computer.
ex.cn: 护士把病人的资料输进了电脑。
ex.note: data 是 datum 的复数形式

ex.en: They hung a few paper decorations before the party.
ex.cn: 聚会前他们挂了几张纸装饰品。
ex.note: with decorations 装饰一新

ex.en: The last train departs at eleven in the evening.
ex.cn: 末班车晚上十一点开。
ex.note: depart from 离开

ex.en: Her quiet determination carried the family through a hard winter.
ex.cn: 她那份沉静的决心把这个家带过了寒冬。

ex.en: The light in the attic was too dim to read by.
ex.cn: 阁楼里的光线太暗，看不清书。

ex.en: The old man dimmed the lamp and began to talk.
ex.cn: 老人把灯调暗，开始说话。

ex.en: She turned away in disgust when she saw the state of the kitchen.
ex.cn: 看到厨房那副样子，她厌恶地转过身去。
ex.note: in disgust 厌恶地；disgust sb. 使某人厌恶

ex.en: You should see a doctor before the cough gets any worse.
ex.cn: 咳嗽再加重之前，你该去看医生。
ex.note: Doctor of Philosophy 哲学博士

ex.en: The school drama club meets every Friday in the old hall.
ex.cn: 学校戏剧社每周五在老礼堂活动。
ex.note: drama in … ……中的戏剧性事件

ex.en: It is your duty to lock the door when you leave.
ex.cn: 你走的时候有义务把门锁上。
ex.note: on duty 值班；a duty of care 照护责任

ex.en: Good teachers educate students to think for themselves.
ex.cn: 好老师会教育学生独立思考。
ex.note: educate sb. to do sth. 教某人做某事

ex.en: Is there anything else you would like to eat?
ex.cn: 你还想吃点别的什么吗？
ex.note: or else 否则；nothing else 没有别的

ex.en: She had so much energy that she was never tired before midnight.
ex.cn: 她精力特别旺，从不到半夜就累。
ex.note: energy 不可数名词

ex.en: The new equipment made the office work much faster.
ex.cn: 新设备让办公室的工作快了许多。
ex.note: equipment 不可数名词

ex.en: The evolution of the town took less than a century.
ex.cn: 这座镇子的演变不到一百年。
ex.note: the evolution of … ……的演变

ex.en: The company plans the expansion of its business into smaller towns.
ex.cn: 公司计划把业务扩张到较小的城镇。
ex.note: the expansion of … ……的扩张

ex.en: The cold wind burned the colour out of her face.
ex.cn: 冷风把她脸上的血色都吹没了。

ex.en: We must face the possibility of another delay.
ex.cn: 我们必须面对再次延期的可能。
ex.note: face difficulty 面临困难

ex.en: They walked farther than they had planned and had to return in the dark.
ex.cn: 他们走得太远，天黑后才不得不往回赶。
ex.note: farther 修饰距离，further 表示程度

ex.en: My fellow students shared their notes with me before the exam.
ex.cn: 同学们在考试前把笔记借给了我。

ex.en: Fellow workers often face the same problems.
ex.cn: 同行常常遇到同样的难处。
ex.note: fellow students 同学们；fellow workers 同工

ex.en: He finished the report before the deadline.
ex.cn: 他在截止日期前完成了报告。

ex.en: From the top of the hill the finish of the race was still a long way off.
ex.cn: 从山顶望过去，赛跑的终点还很远。
ex.note: from start to finish 自始至终

ex.en: A small amount of fluid leaked out of the pipe.
ex.cn: 管子漏出一点液体。
ex.note: in fluid form 以液态

ex.en: The situation in the market is fluid, so keep an open mind.
ex.cn: 市场情况变化不定，要保持开放的心态。
ex.note: fluid situation 流动的形势

ex.en: Please change the format of the report to A4.
ex.cn: 请把报告的格式改成 A4。
ex.note: in a simple format 以简单的格式

ex.en: He spent an hour formatting the text before printing it.
ex.cn: 打印前他花了一个小时给这段文字排版。
ex.note: format a disk 格式化磁盘

ex.en: A friendship built on honest talk survives any distance.
ex.cn: 建立在坦诚交谈之上的友谊，经得起任何距离。

ex.en: He gambled his last savings on a plan that never worked.
ex.cn: 他把最后的积蓄押在一个从未成功的计划上。
ex.note: gamble on 把…押在…上；take a gamble 冒险

ex.en: We got to the station ten minutes before the bus left.
ex.cn: 我们在巴士开走前十分钟赶到了车站。
ex.note: get along with 与…相处；get used to 习惯于

ex.en: The view from the window was gorgeous in the evening light.
ex.cn: 傍晚的光线里，窗外的景色美极了。

ex.en: The council is looking for green ways to reduce traffic in the town.
ex.cn: 市议会正在寻找减少镇上车流的环保办法。

ex.en: They sat on the green and watched the clouds move.
ex.cn: 他们坐在草地上看云走。
ex.note: green fingers 园艺高手

ex.en: Her hair had turned completely white since the last visit.
ex.cn: 自从上次见面，她的头发全白了。

ex.en: He looked at the old photograph without hatred, only sadness.
ex.cn: 他看着那张旧照片，心里没有恨，只有难过。

ex.en: A hen walked into the kitchen and laid an egg by the door.
ex.cn: 一只母鸡走进厨房，在门边下了一个蛋。

ex.en: He drilled a small hole in the wall for the wire.
ex.cn: 他在墙上钻了个小孔走电线。
ex.note: a hole in 在…的漏洞

ex.en: After twenty years as a housewife, she opened a small cake shop.
ex.cn: 做了二十年家庭主妇之后，她开了一家小小的蛋糕店。

ex.en: If the weather is bad, we will stay at home.
ex.cn: 要是天气不好，我们就待在家里。
ex.note: even if 即使；whether … or if … 是否

ex.en: The quiet village made a deep impression on him.
ex.cn: 这个安静的村子给他留下了深刻的印象。
ex.note: make an impression on sb. 给某人留下印象

ex.en: A quick treatment stopped the infection from spreading.
ex.cn: 及时的治疗止住了感染扩散。

ex.en: His old teacher inspired him to keep studying physics.
ex.cn: 他的老老师激励他继续学物理。
ex.note: inspire sb. to do sth. 激励某人做某事

ex.en: The clinic bought its first computer so that it could reach the internet.
ex.cn: 诊所买了第一台电脑，好能连上互联网。
ex.note: on the internet 在互联网上

ex.en: She spread plum jam on her toast for breakfast.
ex.cn: 她早餐时把李子酱抹在吐司上。

ex.en: Thousands of people jammed into the station before the holiday.
ex.cn: 假期前，成千上万的人挤进了车站。
ex.note: traffic jam 交通堵塞

ex.en: The court spent three days seeking justice for the family.
ex.cn: 法庭花了三天才为这家人讨回公道。
ex.note: social justice 社会正义；in justice to 为了…的公正起见

ex.en: There was a lack of medicine in the village clinic during the winter.
ex.cn: 冬天村里的诊所药品短缺。
ex.note: a lack of 缺乏

ex.en: A thin layer of dust covered the old piano.
ex.cn: 旧钢琴上覆着薄薄一层灰。
ex.note: a layer of 一层

ex.en: His grandfather taught him a lesson he never forgot.
ex.cn: 祖父教了他一课，他一辈子都忘不了。
ex.note: take lessons 上课；learn a lesson 吸取教训

ex.en: He made a list of everything the clinic still needed.
ex.cn: 他把诊所还缺的东西列成了一张清单。

ex.en: She listed the names of all the patients on the screen.
ex.cn: 她在屏幕上把病人的名字一个个列了出来。
ex.note: a waiting list 候补名单

ex.en: A lorry carrying sand blocked the narrow road.
ex.cn: 一辆运沙的卡车堵住了窄路。
ex.note: 美式英语中叫 truck

ex.en: The main reason for the delay was heavy rain.
ex.cn: 延误的主要原因是大雨。

ex.en: The main line of the railway was cut by the flood.
ex.cn: 铁路干线被洪水冲断了。
ex.note: the main line 干线

ex.en: He put on a mask before he entered the ward.
ex.cn: 进病房前他戴上了口罩。

ex.en: He tried to mask his disappointment with a smile.
ex.cn: 他用笑容掩饰自己的失望。
ex.note: mask a face 用面具遮住脸

ex.en: The medicine helped, but the cough came back.
ex.cn: 药是有用的，可咳嗽又回来了。
ex.note: take medicine 服药

ex.en: He spent twenty years working in a military hospital.
ex.cn: 他在一家军医院工作了二十年。

ex.en: Only a small military unit was left in the town.
ex.cn: 镇上只剩下一个小小的驻军。

ex.en: A moderate amount of exercise is good for you.
ex.cn: 适量的运动对身体有好处。
ex.note: moderate price 中等价位

ex.en: He mounted a new picture on the wall above the desk.
ex.cn: 他在书桌上方的墙上挂了一张新画。

ex.en: They rode up the mount on horseback.
ex.cn: 他们骑马上了那座山。
ex.note: mount a horse 骑马

ex.en: There was a nasty smell coming from the drain.
ex.cn: 阴沟里飘出一股难闻的气味。
ex.note: a nasty cough 严重的咳嗽

ex.en: He cast his net and pulled in a good catch.
ex.cn: 他撒下网，捕到了不少鱼。
ex.note: safety net 安全网；the Internet 互联网

ex.en: After all the expenses, the net profit was very small.
ex.cn: 扣除所有开支后，净利润很少。
ex.note: net profit 净利润

ex.en: She normally takes the bus to work.
ex.cn: 她通常坐公交车上班。

ex.en: The rules oblige every company to pay for the repair.
ex.cn: 规定要求每家公司都为这次维修付费。
ex.note: oblige sb. to do sth. 迫使某人做某事

ex.en: Do not omit your address when you fill in the form.
ex.cn: 填表时别漏掉地址。
ex.note: omit to do 省略做某事

ex.en: The old organ in the school hall still works well.
ex.cn: 学校礼堂里那架旧风琴还很好用。
ex.note: internal organs 内脏器官

ex.en: She overcame her fear and went back on the stage.
ex.cn: 她克服了恐惧，重新登上了舞台。
ex.note: overcome difficulties 克服困难

ex.en: There was a moment of panic when the lights went out.
ex.cn: 灯灭的那一刻，现场有一阵恐慌。

ex.en: Do not panic; the doctor is on the way.
ex.cn: 别慌，医生马上就到。
ex.note: panic about 对…感到恐慌

ex.en: He sewed a patch onto the back of his old coat.
ex.cn: 他在旧外套的背上缝了一块补丁。

ex.en: He patched the hole in the roof with a piece of tin.
ex.cn: 他用一块铁皮把屋顶的洞补上了。
ex.note: patch up 修补

ex.en: The cake was perfect, and everyone asked for the recipe.
ex.cn: 蛋糕完美极了，人人都问做法。

ex.en: She added a ring of fruit to perfect the decoration.
ex.cn: 她加上一圈水果，让摆盘更加完美。

ex.en: Einstein is the physicist that most people know by name.
ex.cn: 爱因斯坦是大多数人能叫出名字的物理学家。

ex.en: She pushed her plate away without touching the food.
ex.cn: 她一口没吃，把盘子推到了一边。

ex.en: He avoided politics at dinner and talked about football instead.
ex.cn: 晚饭时他避开了政治话题，转而聊足球。

ex.en: The final exam has been postponed until next month.
ex.cn: 期末考试推迟到了下个月。
ex.note: postpone doing 推迟做某事

ex.en: All the members were present at the meeting.
ex.cn: 所有成员都出席了会议。
ex.note: be present at 出席

ex.en: He received a small present on his birthday.
ex.cn: 生日那天他收到了一份小礼物。

ex.en: She presented the report to the committee on Friday.
ex.cn: 她星期五把报告提交给了委员会。
ex.note: present sb. with sth. 把某物赠予某人

ex.en: He will probably arrive after the meeting starts.
ex.cn: 他大概会在会议开始之后才到。

ex.en: The prospect of a job abroad made him nervous.
ex.cn: 出国工作的前景让他心里发慌。

ex.en: The company sent a team to prospect for oil in the north.
ex.cn: 公司派了一支队伍去北方勘探石油。
ex.note: prospect for 勘探；the prospect of doing … …的可能性

ex.en: He came back with one purpose: to see his grandmother.
ex.cn: 他回来只有一个目的：看看奶奶。
ex.note: on purpose 故意；for the purpose of 为了…的目的

ex.en: The rain stopped just before the bus arrived.
ex.cn: 巴士到站前雨刚好停了。

ex.en: It rained hard all afternoon and the roads flooded.
ex.cn: 整个下午都在下雨，路面都淹了。
ex.note: rain heavily 下大雨

ex.en: Please keep to the rear of the hall; the front rows are reserved.
ex.cn: 请坐在礼堂后面，前排是留给别人的。

ex.en: The kitchen is at the rear of the house.
ex.cn: 厨房在房子的后面。

ex.en: She reared three children on her own after the divorce.
ex.cn: 离婚后她独自抚养三个孩子。
ex.note: rear children 抚养孩子

ex.en: A cold shower refreshes him after a long day.
ex.cn: 忙了一天后，冷水澡让他精神一振。
ex.note: refresh the page 刷新页面

ex.en: He was reluctant to say goodbye, but the train was waiting.
ex.cn: 他不太情愿道别，可火车已经在等了。
ex.note: be reluctant to do 不情愿做某事

ex.en: He resembles his grandmother more than his father.
ex.cn: 他长得更像奶奶，而不是父亲。
ex.note: resemble sb. in … 在某方面像某人

ex.en: The old letters revealed a story the family had never told.
ex.cn: 那些旧信揭开了家里从未讲过的往事。
ex.note: reveal the truth 揭露真相

ex.en: The model rocket reached the top of the hill in seconds.
ex.cn: 火箭模型几秒钟就飞到了山顶。
ex.note: rocket science 高深的科学

ex.en: The gate was covered with rust and would not open easily.
ex.cn: 门上满是锈，很难拉开。

ex.en: Old iron tools rust quickly in the damp air.
ex.cn: 旧铁工具在潮湿的空气里很快生锈。
ex.note: rust away 锈蚀殆尽

ex.en: He picked up a saw and began to cut the board.
ex.cn: 他拿起一把锯，开始锯木板。

ex.en: He sawed the plank into two pieces.
ex.cn: 他把木板锯成了两截。
ex.note: saw 是 see 的过去式，注意区分

ex.en: The school still needs a script for the winter play.
ex.cn: 学校还需要为冬季话剧准备一份剧本。
ex.note: script file 脚本文件

ex.en: He had a strong sense that something was wrong.
ex.cn: 他有一种强烈的感觉，觉得哪里不对劲。

ex.en: I sensed that she was not telling the truth.
ex.cn: 我感觉到她没有说实话。
ex.note: sense that … 感觉到

ex.en: The cloud had the shape of a bird.
ex.cn: 那朵云的形状像一只鸟。

ex.en: Teachers shape the way their students think.
ex.cn: 老师塑造着学生思考的方式。
ex.note: shape the future 塑造未来

ex.en: A short shower came and went while we were having lunch.
ex.cn: 我们吃午饭时下了一阵急雨，说停就停了。
ex.note: take a shower 洗淋浴

ex.en: The little boat was sinking fast, and no one could reach it.
ex.cn: 小船正在迅速下沉，谁也够不着它。

ex.en: He washed the dishes in the sink by the window.
ex.cn: 他在窗边的水槽里洗碗。
ex.note: kitchen sink 厨房水槽

ex.en: The road climbs a gentle slope behind the village.
ex.cn: 这条路从村子后面沿着一个缓坡往上爬。
ex.note: on the slope of 在…的斜坡上

ex.en: The sole survivor of the crash was a boy of seven.
ex.cn: 那场车祸中唯一的幸存者是个七岁的男孩。

ex.en: Mud stuck to the sole of his boot.
ex.cn: 泥粘在他的靴子底上。
ex.note: the sole of one’s shoe 鞋底

ex.en: A drawing of a spacecraft hung above the teacher's desk.
ex.cn: 一幅宇宙飞船的图画挂在老师的书桌上方。
ex.note: spacecraft 单复数同形

ex.en: From the hilltop the view of the whole valley was splendid.
ex.cn: 从山顶望下去，整条山谷壮丽无比。

ex.en: The old building is in a poor state after so many years.
ex.cn: 这栋老楼过了这么多年，已经破败不堪。

ex.en: She stated her reasons clearly at the meeting.
ex.cn: 她在会上清楚地说出了自己的理由。
ex.note: state that … 陈述

ex.en: The bus stops twice on the way to the village.
ex.cn: 巴士去村子的路上停两站。

ex.en: The bus stop is at the end of the lane.
ex.cn: 巴士站在巷子尽头。

ex.en: She is a first-year student in the engineering department.
ex.cn: 她是工程系的大一学生。

ex.en: He summarized the whole report in a single page.
ex.cn: 他用一页纸把整份报告做了总结。
ex.note: summarize the main points 总结要点

ex.en: They carried out a survey of the damaged road.
ex.cn: 他们对受损路段做了一次调查。

ex.en: From the top of the hill they surveyed the whole valley.
ex.cn: 他们从山顶俯瞰了整条山谷。
ex.note: survey n. 调查；survey v. 调查/俯瞰

ex.en: It takes about two hours to get to the city by bus.
ex.cn: 坐公交车到城里大约要两个小时。
ex.note: take a bus 乘公交车；take place 发生

ex.en: The nurse took his temperature every four hours.
ex.cn: 护士每四小时给他量一次体温。
ex.note: run a fever 发烧

ex.en: The theme of the exhibition was the history of the old town.
ex.cn: 展览的主题是古镇的历史。
ex.note: the theme of … ……的主题

ex.en: She tied the old letters together with a length of thread.
ex.cn: 她用一截细线把那些旧信扎在一起。

ex.en: He threaded the needle without even looking.
ex.cn: 他没看就把针穿好了。
ex.note: thread a needle 穿针引线

ex.en: He kept a box of tissue on the bedside table.
ex.cn: 他在床头柜上放了一盒纸巾。
ex.note: tissue paper 纸巾；muscle tissue 肌肉组织

ex.en: She dried her hands on the towel hanging on the door.
ex.cn: 她用挂在门上的毛巾擦干手。

ex.en: The two sides signed a treaty and the dispute was settled.
ex.cn: 双方签了协议，纠纷就此解决。
ex.note: a peace treaty 和平条约

ex.en: Turn left at the bridge and the school is on your right.
ex.cn: 在桥左转，学校就在你右手边。

ex.en: Let me have a turn at the machine after you.
ex.cn: 你用完之后让我也用一下机器。

ex.en: It is unfair to judge people by their first impression.
ex.cn: 凭第一印象评判别人是不公平的。

ex.en: This little guide was more useful than we expected.
ex.cn: 这份小小的说明比我们预想的还要有用。

ex.en: The wall of the cliff here is almost vertical.
ex.cn: 这里的崖壁几乎是垂直的。
ex.note: a vertical line 一条竖线

ex.en: The nurse told him to take one vitamin tablet each morning.
ex.cn: 护士告诉他每天早上服一片维生素。

ex.en: The villagers had to walk three miles for clean water.
ex.cn: 村民们要走三英里才能取到干净的水。

ex.en: He watered the tomatoes every evening.
ex.cn: 他每天傍晚给西红柿浇水。

ex.en: She sings well and plays the piano even better.
ex.cn: 她歌唱得好，钢琴弹得更好。

ex.en: He looked well after a week of rest.
ex.cn: 休息了一星期，他看上去气色不错。
ex.note: do well 干得好；well enough 足够好

ex.en: There is an old well at the back of the house.
ex.cn: 屋后有一口老井。

ex.en: The story is known widely among the villagers.
ex.cn: 这件事在村民中广为流传。
ex.note: widely used 广泛使用；widely known 广为人知

ex.en: A wooden shelf stood against the wall.
ex.cn: 墙边立着一个木架。

ex.en: Yeah, I would love to see them again.
ex.cn: 是啊，我很想再见他们。
